title: WTT Star Contender Muscat day five preview: Sun Yang meets Park Ganghyeon as Odo chases three titles
seo_title: WTT Star Contender Muscat day 5 preview and UK times
description: WTT Star Contender Muscat day five: Sun Yang v Park Ganghyeon, Lim Jonghoon v Oh Junsung, the quarter-finals and both doubles finals, with UK times.
standfirst: The last 16 and quarter-finals of both singles draws are played on Friday in Oman, and the women's and men's doubles titles are decided in the evening.
body: Sun Yang, the 18-year-old qualifier who knocked out the top seed Darko Jorgic, plays South Korea's Park Ganghyeon in the last 16 of WTT Star Contender Muscat on Friday, the busiest day of the week in Oman. Both singles draws go from 16 players to four, and the women's and men's doubles titles are decided in the evening session.

Play starts at 6am UK time (10am in Muscat) with four last-16 matches at once, including the women's top seed Satsuki Odo against France's Audrey Zarif and the men's second seed Shunsuke Togami against Joe Seyfried. The last 16 finish at about 8.20am, the eight quarter-finals run from 11am to about 3.05pm, and the women's doubles final starts at 4pm, followed by the men's at 4.50pm.
## The big matches
**Sun Yang v Park Ganghyeon (6.35am UK)**

Sun, a Chinese defender ranked 228th, has won five matches in four days, the last of them a 3-1 win over Jorgic, the world No 14, as Eleven's [day four review](/news/wtt-star-contender-muscat-2026-day-four-review-results-highlights.html) described. Park, 30 and the world No 44, needed only three games to beat his compatriot An Jaehyun, the 14th seed. The winner plays Croatia's Tomislav Pucar, the ninth seed, or France's Flavien Coton, the eighth, in the quarter-finals at 11.35am. Pucar beat Coton 3-0 at WTT Champions Frankfurt this month.
**Lim Jonghoon v Oh Junsung (6.35am UK)**

The two South Koreans are the top seeds in the men's doubles and play the final together against India's Manav Thakkar and Manush Shah at 4.50pm. First they meet each other. Oh, 20 and the fifth seed, is ranked 19th; Lim, 29 and the 12th seed, is 34th. Lim won their first two meetings in Eleven's records, but Oh beat him 3-0 in the last 16 at WTT Champions Yokohama in August. The winner meets Russia's Vladimir Sidorenko, the fourth seed, or Romania's Iulian Chirita, the 20-year-old who knocked out Simon Gauzy.
**Satsuki Odo v Audrey Zarif (6am UK)**

Odo, 22 and the world No 10, faces the longest day of anyone in Muscat. After the singles she plays the mixed doubles semi-final with Togami at 8.20am, a quarter-final at 12.10pm if she wins and the women's doubles final with Sakura Yokoi at 4pm. Zarif, 28 and ranked 108th, beat Canada's Mo Zhang, the 15th seed, in straight games on Thursday. The winner meets South Korea's Kim Nayeong, the ninth seed, or Russia's Elizabet Abraamian, the European champion and eighth seed.
**Dimitrij Ovtcharov v Kwon Hyuk (7.45am UK)**

There are 20 years between them. Ovtcharov, 38 and the world No 21, is the seventh seed; Kwon, 18, came through qualifying ranked 106th and knocked out Egypt's Omar Assar, the 10th seed, 11-4 in the fifth game on Thursday. Ovtcharov is not in Germany's squad for the Mixed Team World Cup, which starts in Chengdu on 29 November, because the federation said a long event would [come too soon](/news/mixed-team-world-cup-2026-germany-squad-winter-franziska-ovtcharov.html) after his upper-arm injury. The winner plays Togami or Seyfried in the last quarter-final, at 3.05pm.
**Honoka Hashimoto v Kim Seongjin (7.45am UK)**

Hashimoto, the Japanese defender who won WTT Contender Istanbul last Sunday, is the second seed and the world No 14. Kim, 21 and ranked 80th, led Taiwan's Yeh Yi-Tian by two games on Thursday, let the lead go and then won the decider 12-10. The winner plays Yokoi, the sixth seed, or Taiwan's Cheng I-Ching in the first quarter-final of the day, at 11am. Cheng, 34, beat Yokoi in their only meeting in Eleven's records, in July 2025.
## Japan's women and China's men

Six of the 16 women left are Japanese, and two all-Japanese quarter-finals are possible. Miyu Nagasaki, the fourth seed, plays Monaco's Xiaoxin Yang, 38, at 7.10am; Nagasaki has won both of their meetings since 2023, the last in February. On the next table Kaho Akae, the 12th seed, meets China's Qin Yuxuan, the seventh seed, and the two winners play each other at 1.55pm. Sachi Aoki, 19, meets Bernadette Szőcs at 6.35am in a repeat of their last 32 match at WTT Star Contender Ljubljana in June, which Aoki won 11-6 in the fifth game. Szőcs, the fifth seed, then plays the mixed doubles semi-final with Eduard Ionescu at 8.20am.

China have four men in the last 16 but cannot have more than two in the semi-finals. Yuan Licen, a qualifier, plays Li Tianyang, 19, at 6.35am, and the winner meets Hiroto Shinozuka or Chen Yuanyu, who play at 7.10am. Chen beat Shinozuka, the sixth seed, in the quarter-finals at WTT Contender Zagreb in June. China's other woman left, Wang Xiaotong, plays South Korea's Joo Cheonhui, the third seed and last year's runner-up in Muscat, at 6am; Wang won their only meeting in Eleven's records, in 2024.
Neither of last year's champions, Félix Lebrun and Miyuu Kihara, is in Muscat, so there will be new winners of both singles titles on Saturday.
## Doubles finals and mixed semi-finals

The women's doubles final, at 4pm, is between the top two seeds: South Korea's Kim Nayeong and Joo Cheonhui, who beat Saki Shibata and Sachi Aoki 3-1 in the semi-finals, and Odo and Yokoi, who dropped 19 points in beating Szőcs and Elizabeta Samara. In the men's final at 4.50pm Lim and Oh play Thakkar and Shah, who beat Gauzy and Coton 3-1 in the semi-finals.

In the mixed doubles semi-finals at 8.20am, France's Esteban Dorr and Jia Nan Yuan, who knocked out the top seeds, meet Ionescu and Szőcs, and Australia's Nicholas Lum and Yangzi Liu play Togami and Odo.
## Order of play
Times are approximate and UK time.

- 6am, last 16: Satsuki Odo v Audrey Zarif (women); Wang Xiaotong v Joo Cheonhui (women); Joe Seyfried v Shunsuke Togami (men); Sakura Yokoi v Cheng I-Ching (women)
- 6.35am, last 16: Sun Yang v Park Ganghyeon (men); Yuan Licen v Li Tianyang (men); Bernadette Szőcs v Sachi Aoki (women); Lim Jonghoon v Oh Junsung (men)
- 7.10am, last 16: Kaho Akae v Qin Yuxuan (women); Kim Nayeong v Elizabet Abraamian (women); Hiroto Shinozuka v Chen Yuanyu (men); Miyu Nagasaki v Xiaoxin Yang (women)
- 7.45am, last 16: Vladimir Sidorenko v Iulian Chirita (men); Dimitrij Ovtcharov v Kwon Hyuk (men); Tomislav Pucar v Flavien Coton (men); Kim Seongjin v Honoka Hashimoto (women)
- 8.20am, mixed doubles semi-finals: Esteban Dorr and Jia Nan Yuan v Eduard Ionescu and Bernadette Szőcs; Nicholas Lum and Yangzi Liu v Shunsuke Togami and Satsuki Odo
- 11am: women's quarter-final (Yokoi or Cheng v Kim Seongjin or Hashimoto)
- 11.35am: men's quarter-final (Sun or Park v Pucar or Coton)
- 12.10pm: women's quarter-final (Odo or Zarif v Kim Nayeong or Abraamian)
- 12.45pm: men's quarter-final (Sidorenko or Chirita v Lim or Oh)
- 1.20pm: women's quarter-final (Szőcs or Aoki v Wang Xiaotong or Joo)
- 1.55pm: women's quarter-final (Nagasaki or Yang v Akae or Qin)
- 2.30pm: men's quarter-final (Shinozuka or Chen Yuanyu v Yuan or Li)
- 3.05pm: men's quarter-final (Ovtcharov or Kwon v Seyfried or Togami)
- 4pm: women's doubles final, Kim Nayeong and Joo Cheonhui v Satsuki Odo and Sakura Yokoi
- 4.50pm: men's doubles final, Lim Jonghoon and Oh Junsung v Manav Thakkar and Manush Shah
## How to watch

WTT streams every table on its YouTube channel. Eleven's [event page](/events/wtt-star-contender-muscat-2026.html#matches) has live scores, the full draw and the order of play. Singles matches are best of five games until the semi-finals, which are played on Saturday 21 November with the finals.
## Thursday in brief

Sun's win over Jorgic was the result of the day. Odo and Hashimoto came through in four games, Szőcs came from two games down to end the run of the 17-year-old qualifier Wei Jingming, and Kwon and Chirita knocked out seeds. The full results are in Eleven's [day four review](/news/wtt-star-contender-muscat-2026-day-four-review-results-highlights.html).
